tab.handle: <the iMessage number or address you text Tab on>
tab.what: Tab (tab.bot): texting AI agent with its own phone line; private beta, join the waitlist
tab.notes: Standard German only (regional dialect may trip it). Caller ID is a US number. May keep recording silently after a voicemail unless told to hang up. Says it is an AI when asked.

pally.handle: <the iMessage number you text Pally on>
pally.what: Pally (pally.com): texting AI assistant; calls included on the free plan, usage allowance refills a fraction per day
pally.notes: Gives the callback number saved on your own profile unless the task says otherwise: always say 'give only what is in the task'. Permissions for a call can expire at night.

fo.handle: <the iMessage number you text Fo on>
fo.what: Fo by Wajo (wajo.ai): texting AI agent; free tier with an undisclosed daily cap
fo.notes: Opens by saying it is an AI and that the call is recorded. Looped for hours against a voice-bot receptionist and drained its allowance: mark it depleted afterwards. Its end-call control can refuse, so a time limit in the task is not enforceable.

arlo.handle: <the iMessage number you text Arlo on>
arlo.what: Arlo (arlo.sh): texting AI assistant; pay per talking minute
arlo.notes: Only dials US and Canadian numbers; listed so nobody re-tests it for international calls.
